notes: Config-driven snapshot trainer (medium, total 9): the agent authors /app/train.py (CSV+config -> trained state-dict snapshot) and produces /app/model_snapshot.pt on the visible fixture. The verifier reloads the snapshot with torch.load(weights_only=True) and enforces that it is a REAL weights file at exactly the configured layer/width node counts (key set + shapes vs /app/config.json), finite and non-degenerate (catches dummy/zero/all-equal files), modestly sized (catches oversized dumps), and >=0.85 held-out accuracy (catches untrained snapshots) -- the full missing/dummy/oversized failure surface of the artifact competency. It then RE-EXECUTES the deliverable trainer on three hidden cases that vary input_dim (5/6/10), hidden_units (8/16/32), num_classes (2/3/4), epochs, lr, batch size, and seed, applying the same checks to each freshly produced snapshot (hidden_case_generalization=2, quantitative_correctness=2). Single-stage pipeline on a small dataset keeps resource_pressure=0 and no statefulness.
